quarterly_data.signal: CEO Bill Brennan sized the addressable market: 'as we look at the markets that we address now, you can measure that market opportunity in tens of billions of dollars', calling Credo still early in its growth story. On M&A he said Credo has made three acquisitions: a group in Canada focused on MicroLED technology (brought in-house instead of working with startups), CoMira (protocol and security) and Dust (leading-edge PIC technology). He will keep buying engineering teams and technology, and any move outside core connectivity would have to be 'a very differentiated system-level solution'.
quarterly_data.figure: market opportunity in tens of billions of dollars; three acquisitions (MicroLED team, CoMira, Dust)
